name: MLKE
description: A benchmark for evaluating multilingual knowledge editing capabilities of large language models, measuring how models update, overwrite, and maintain facts across languages.
evaluation_method: exact_match / editing_success (accuracy-like measures for edited facts)
reputation: Newer benchmark focused on multilingual knowledge editing with growing interest among researchers studying model updatability and factual consistency.
notes: Risk of contamination from pretraining corpora across many languages; evaluation typically measures both edit success and retention (non-target degradation).
